description: One Forever serve slot, ungrouped: the live runner puts quest QUEST_ID in A's quest log beforehand and the first step records the log. A walks to the quest target (TARGET_X/Y/Z), attacks a MOB_ENTRY mob and waits up to WAIT_S for a pool bot on the same quest to invite it. A accepts (the result names the inviter), proves party membership, then works two more MOB_ENTRY mobs: the closing combat_near over 40 s must count at least one party hit, so the bot fights the same target. A leaves the group at the end. Set QUEST_ID, TARGET_X/Y/Z and MOB_ENTRY before the run; the file declares no default for them and `scenario check` refuses to load without every one.

steps.title: A's quest log names the target quest

steps.note: the runner accepted QUEST_ID before the run; the recorded log shows it

steps.title: A stands on the quest target and attacks a MOB_ENTRY mob

steps.note: units is nearest first, so 0 is the nearest MOB_ENTRY within 60 yd

steps.title: a bot on the same quest invites A

steps.note: no invite means no bot on this quest met A within WAIT_S (the baseline)
the result names the inviter (inviter, inviter_guid)

steps.title: A works two more MOB_ENTRY mobs while the bot fights with it
a party member hit A's target in the last 40 s

steps.name: the bot fights A's target
steps.note: at least one hit from a group member, never another player's
